Two types declare `RunOnce`, both in `server/runner/`:

**`*memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — not invoked — no caller**
The graph returns a certified zero for callers of `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce`, and a repo-wide text search for `RunOnce` across all `*.go` files finds only its own declaration line (plus the doc comment) — no call site in production or test code. This is dead code today; it's the "rebuild the payload of all memos" batch job, presumably kept for migration/manual use.

**`*s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked — two callers**
- `s3presign.Runner.Run` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`, the ticker loop calling it on each tick
- `server.Server.startBackgroundRunners` — `server/server.go:163`, one eager invocation at startup (`s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)`) before the continuous loop is started at `server/server.go:165`

Note the two declarations are unrelated structurally — there is no shared `RunOnce` interface; the name collision is a convention across runner packages, not a contract. That's why the initial `[ArchMap query]` result merged both declarers and had to be split by qualified name.
